Hi Anna — thanks for the PO and the VAT sheet. Quick answers up front:

- We can emit a single consolidated PDF invoice that contains separate line-item blocks per legal entity showing the corresponding VAT registration number and billing address. We can also produce separate invoices per entity if your AP requires distinct documents for each legal entity.
- Delivery channels we support for AC-449: Peppol (preferred), SFTP (secure drop), and email PDF to AP. Peppol is available for EU entities and is our recommended default for faster processing; SFTP is used for bulk automated ingestion; email is supported as a fallback.

Next steps / asks from our side:
1) Please confirm whether Acme wants separate invoices per legal entity or one consolidated invoice with entity-level breakdowns.
2) If you want Peppol, can you send your Peppol participant ID and the target endpoint? We can ping our E-invoicing partner to whitelist.
3) Confirm the exact filename convention you want (we will include the PO always).

Looping in Laura (Finance Ops) and Marissa (Sales Ops) to scope invoice generation and make sure accounting metadata matches the contract.

—Rachel

Thanks for looping us in, Rachel. A couple of internal notes for the routing decision:

- Finance preference: consolidated invoice per billing cycle is preferred so AP only posts one document, but it must clearly label which line items are attributable to which legal entity and include the matching VAT IDs. That satisfies our credit and tax reporting while minimizing file volume for Acme.
- If Acme requires separate legal-entity invoices for downstream tax reclaim processes, we can produce separate PDFs, but that will change the invoice numbering pattern (we'll append entity suffixes).
- For Peppol: if Acme can provide the participant IDs per entity, we will onboard the endpoint. Peppol is preferable for the EU entities (DE/NL) since it preserves structured VAT fields.
- Filename requirement: we can standardize to PO_ENTITY_YYYYMM.pdf (e.g., AC-449_ACUK_202806.pdf).

I will prepare the invoice template with per-entity blocks and test a Peppol submission once Anna confirms the participant IDs. Marissa — please confirm whether sales needs separate revenue attribution per entity (that impacts our ledger mapping).
